criteria.title: Project Charter Verification
criteria.description: Student read and accepted the project charter.

criteria.title: Design Requirements Identification
criteria.description: Accurately extracts the maximum load, cabin weight, and number of ropes from the charter.

criteria.title: Component Identification (Image Labeling)
criteria.description: Correctly matches the 20 numbered callouts to the corresponding elevator component names.

criteria.title: Free Body Diagram Analysis
criteria.description: Accurately maps the upwards tensile force and downwards gravity vectors on the system.

criteria.title: Working Principle Explanation
criteria.description: Clear explanation of how the traction elevator works, identifying the sheave as the traction source.

criteria.title: Engineering Model Identification
criteria.description: Correctly explains the load path transferring weight to the suspension system.

criteria.title: Material Selection Justification
criteria.description: Selects a high-strength material (e.g., High Carbon Steel) and justifies the choice based on yield strength.

criteria.title: Load, Stress, and Factor of Safety Calculations
criteria.description: Accurate calculation of total passenger load, load per rope, tensile stress, and Factor of Safety. Diameter should be 12mm within +- 1mm tolerance.

criteria.title: Engineering Decision & Justification
criteria.description: Correctly decides SAFE or UNSAFE based on FoS and provides sound engineering justification.
